insurer: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Individual/Family Floater: 5L to 3Cr (by plan). Family First: Base Individual SI 1L to 15L + Floater SI as per formula (by plan).

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: We will provide an additional re-fill amount of maximum up to 100% of the Base Sum Insured.
great.explanation: The policy refills up to 100% of the Base Sum Insured after it is exhausted, allowing more coverage for multiple hospitalizations in the same year.

great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote: If the Base Sum Insured and increased Sum Insured under Loyalty Additions... has been partially or completely exhausted due to claims... then We will provide an additional re-fill amount of maximum up to 100% of the Base Sum Insured.
great.explanation: An extra Sum Insured equal to 100% of the Base SI is available after the main cover and loyalty additions are used up, enhancing protection for multiple claims.

great.name: PED Waiting Period
great.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a Pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy.
great.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are covered after 24 months of continuous coverage, which is better than many policies requiring 36 months.

great.name: Specific Illness Waiting
great.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 12 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy.
great.reference: Section 5.1.1.2 Specified disease/procedure waiting period- Code- Excl02
great.explanation: Common listed surgeries and conditions are covered after 12 months, which is shorter than the typical 24-month waiting period.

great.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
great.quote: We will pay above mentioned Pre-hospitalization Medical Expenses only for period up to 90 days immediately preceding the Insured Person’s admission
great.explanation: Medical expenses up to 90 days before hospitalization are covered when related to the same hospital stay.

great.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
great.quote: We will pay Post-hospitalization Medical Expenses only for up to 180 days immediately following the Insured Person’s discharge
great.explanation: Medical expenses up to 180 days after discharge are covered for the same condition.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any Illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an Accident
good.explanation: Illnesses are covered after 30 days from policy start, while accidents are covered immediately.

good.name: Room Rent
good.quote: Room rent Covered up to Sum Insured (except for Suite or above room category)
good.reference: Annexure II – Product Benefit Table (Individual & Family Floater variant)
good.explanation: Standard rooms have no fixed daily room rent cap, but suites and higher categories are excluded.

good.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.quote: We will indemnify on Reimbursement basis only, the Medical Expenses incurred for the Insured Person’s Domiciliary Hospitalization... The Domiciliary Hospitalization continues for at least 3 consecutive days
good.explanation: Home hospitalization is covered if it lasts at least 3 consecutive days.

good.name: Modern Treatments
good.quote: Modern Treatments Covered up to Sum Insured with sub-limit of Rs. 1Lac on few robotic surgeries
good.reference: Annexure II – Product Benefit Table; also Section 3.25 (robotic special condition)
good.explanation: Modern treatments are covered but robotic surgeries have a ₹1 lakh sub-limit.

good.name: Renewal Bonus
good.quote: We will provide Loyalty Additions... by increasing the Sum Insured... by 10% of the Base Sum Insured... subject to a maximum of 100% of the Base Sum Insured.
good.explanation: Sum Insured increases by 10% of Base SI on renewal, up to 100%, enhancing coverage over time.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: Annexure VII - The expenses that are not covered... List  I – Expenses not covered... 56 GLOVES... 60 MASK... 57 NEBULISATION KIT... 58 ANY KIT WITH NO DETAILS MENTIONED [DELIVERY KIT, ORTHOKIT, RECOVERY KIT, ETC]
bad.reference: Annexure VII - The expenses that are not covered or subsumed...
bad.explanation: Many standard consumables like gloves and masks are excluded, increasing out-of-pocket expenses during hospitalization.

bad.name: Disease Sub-limits
bad.quote: This benefit is covered up to a limit of Rs. 50,000.
bad.explanation: HIV/AIDS treatment has a hard limit of ₹50,000, reducing financial protection for this condition.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: If You select Zone 2, then 20% Co-payment will apply for treatment in Mumbai (including Navi Mumbai & Thane), Delhi NCR, Kolkata & Gujarat State.
bad.explanation: Selecting Zone 2 means you pay 20% of claims in major cities, reducing effective coverage.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: Co-payment (if applicable) shall be applied on the amount payable by Us.
bad.reference: Section 6.2.14 Claim Cost Sharing Option / Conditions; also Section 6.2.11 Zonal pricing
bad.explanation: Co-pay may apply depending on zone or policy schedule, but the policy does not clearly state a universal 0% co-pay.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
